The extraction formula I'm using for the middle name is `=TRIM(MID(E19,LEN(E5)+1,LEN(E19)-LEN(E5&E7)))`, which gives the middle name in E9. Then I'm converting it to proper case with `=PROPER(E9)` in F10, and I'm taking the initial from that result with `=LEFT(F10)` in F7. If F7 contains an initial, I want to add a period after it. # It references F10 (the proper-cased middle name/initial source) and returns blank when no initial exists.
